main.summary:
Engineering leader with 13+ years of experience architecting, building, and scaling cloud-native platforms across startup and consulting environments. Strong technical foundation in distributed systems and AWS-based infrastructure, with a proven ability to establish engineering standards, delivery practices, and scalable architectures from early-stage to growth. Experienced in hiring and mentoring high-performing teams, defining technical roadmaps, and aligning engineering execution with product goals. 

Passionate about the startup ecosystem, serving as a trusted technical advisor to startups in Colombia, guiding architecture, technology selection, and platform design to help them scale effectively. Active contributor to the regional tech community, including speaking at industry events and collaborating with AWS initiatives to foster communities of technology leaders in Colombia. Currently leading organization-wide AI adoption—partnering across engineering, product, operations, and business functions to embed AI into workflows, decision-making, and new product capabilities that drive efficiency and unlock revenue opportunities. Trilingual (Spanish, English, French) with professional experience across Colombia and the United States.

experience.title: Co-Founder / VP. of SWE
bullets: Co-founded logistics-tech startup, architecting the engineering organization and cloud-native infrastructure from day one on AWS
Established DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and security-first development culture across the engineering team

Co-led a company-wide organizational and architectural transformation from a monolithic structure to a domain-driven microservices ecosystem, enabling autonomous squads and unlocking parallel product development and regional scalability.

Operated across multiple leadership roles—including Cloud Architect and Product Manager for Transportation, Monetization, and Support domains—designing and delivering products that improved operational efficiency and enabled new service capabilities.

Defined and implemented a standardized, repeatable technology stack and deployment model, enabling rapid environment replication, automation-first operations, and consistent onboarding of new teams and services.

Partnered with operations, internal and external clients to translate logistics, support and fulfillment challenges into scalable technical solutions; led technical due diligence processes with strategic partners and customers.
Built the engineering function from the ground up: hired and mentored 25+ engineers, defined role architecture and career ladders
Designed and institutionalized the development lifecycle, aligning engineering execution with product management through agile practices, quarterly planning, and OKR-driven delivery.
Architected and implemented the company’s disaster recovery plan and reliability strategy.
Driving cultural adoption through hands-on leadership, mentoring teams on how to incorporate AI into daily development, decision-making, and automation processes.
